def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("car")
    blue_cars = [c for c in car_patches if c.verify_property("car", "blue")]
    if not blue_cars: return image_patch
    turning_cars = [c for c in blue_cars if c.simple_query("Is the car turning?").lower() == "yes"]
    return turning_cars[0] if turning_cars else blue_cars[0]
